items: "She has a long hair and the eyes green." O certo é **She has long hair and green eyes.** (hair não leva *a*, e o adjetivo vem antes)
"He has 35 years." O certo é **He is 35** (years old).

lessons.title: Dedução com must, might e can't
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Dedução no presente: must be, might / may / could be, can't be.

head: Modal
Grau de certeza
Exemplo
rows: quase certeza de que é verdade
She must be tired. She's been working all day.
He might be at home. It could be a mistake.
quase certeza de que NÃO é
That can't be his car. It's too expensive.

aula.text: Para algo acontecendo agora, use o continuous: *He must be working.*

aula.label: Atenção
aula.text: aqui *must* não é obrigação, é dedução. O oposto de *must be* é **can't be**, não mustn't.

items: "He mustn't be at home, the lights are off." O certo é **He can't be at home.**
"He maybe is late." O certo é **He may be late** ou **Maybe he is late.** (maybe, uma palavra, vem antes do sujeito)

exercises.prompt: The lights are on. He ___ (be) at home.
I don't know where she is. She ___ (be) in the car. Not sure.
That ___ (be) his brother. He's an only child.
He mustn't be at home, the lights are off.
acc: He can't be at home, the lights are off
He cannot be at home, the lights are off

exercises.prompt: She's yawning and rubbing her eyes. She ___ (be) tired.

lessons.title: Inglês prático, descrever pessoas e fotos
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Descrever pessoas e fotos.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: He's tall and slim, with short dark hair and a beard. / She looks about 30.
He's wearing a blue shirt and jeans.
She looks friendly. / He seems tired. / It looks like rain.
on the left / on the right / in the middle / in the background / in the foreground
I'm looking for a tall man in a red jacket. Have you seen him?

aula.label: Regra
aula.text: look + adjetivo (*looks tired*). look like + substantivo (*looks like a doctor*).

items: "He looks like tired." O certo é **He looks tired.**
"She is wearing a shirt white." O certo é **a white shirt.**

exercises.prompt: In the ___ of the picture, there's a dog. (ao fundo)
She is wearing a shirt white.
acc: She is wearing a white shirt
she is wearing a white shirt

exercises.prompt: Descreva alguém que você conhece com 3 informações (altura, cabelo, roupa).
exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.
